common_history_argmax_disagreement.estimand: candidate-minus-control disagreement rate with within-case steps kept together

early_free_running_divergence.estimand: candidate-minus-control event rate and first-divergence horizon
early_free_running_divergence.event: cached and recompute greedy tokens first differ before 32 generated tokens
early_free_running_divergence.reason: one low-margin tie-break makes subsequent histories incomparable; dense diverges in 15-27% of v2 cases and 90%-powered five-point NI requires up to 1683 cases per seed/length

hard_guardrails: no cached/recompute disagreement when the full-path top-1/top-2 margin is at least 0.5 logits
every strict operator/state/export prerequisite remains passed

high_margin_argmax_disagreement.estimand: candidate-minus-control disagreement rate among full-path margins at or above 0.1 logits
high_margin_argmax_disagreement.unit: case with eligible steps pooled inside the case

strict_operator_state_export.rule: existing isolated operator, state, gradient, checkpoint, and CPU Transformers export parity thresholds remain mandatory

statistics.candidate_decision: each KDA seed must pass separately; no averaging away a failed seed
statistics.length_decision: every primary endpoint and hard guardrail must pass separately at 8, 64, 512, and 4096 tokens
statistics.multiplicity: intersection-union gate across primary endpoints, lengths, and seeds; every primary cell must pass
